details:
STARBOUND: The Lost Space Key is a space adventure game created using Canva. Our idea started with a simple question: What if four friends suddenly woke up on a mysterious planet after a sleepover?

The game follows Vennia, Isaac, Emily and Sophia as they try to find their way back to Earth. Along the journey, they meet a robot companion named Z-7, travel through space using a spaceship, explore the Moon and other mysterious places, answer space-related quizzes and collect Space Keys to unlock a portal home.

We wanted to create something that is not only fun to play but also helps people learn about space. Through the quizzes and challenges, players can discover interesting facts about planets, stars and the universe while practising their problem-solving skills.

We used Canva to design the game backgrounds, characters, buttons and scenes. We also used AI tools to help generate some images and improve our project ideas and written content.

What makes our game special is the combination of an imaginative storyline, colourful space environments and educational activities. Our hope is to make learning about space more enjoyable and inspire more young people to become curious about science, technology and the universe.
